contract.split_mechanism: A distinct native performance purpose using a pinned published context for eligible primitive signature warming, with explicit fallback. Existing526owners remain byte-identical.
semantic_invariants: Pin published snapshot belonging to the exact chain manager and pool, with explicit UTXO/rule coverage and immutable next-block script flags.
Only native final-sequence/zero-lock supported contexts use snapshot facts; partial, missing or foreign contexts fall back to existing locked preparation.
Snapshot negatives may suppress advisory work but never return a transaction verdict; final admission resolves current authoritative coins, rules, limits and signing messages again.
Primitive cache keys bind exact signature/public-key/message/configured domain; stale or invalid signatures cannot authorize changed facts.
No EnsureVectors reconstruction, primary membership duplicate, new wire/finality behavior or 4KiB cache refinement.
